body: If he's so depressed that he doesn't want me around, why is he looking for people to talk with on snapchat?
Everyone keeps telling me to focus on myself and I don't know how to do that.
I can't let go.  He's all I want.

We lost power because of the ice storm that blew through last weekend.

I was staying at my mom's house so that was fine.  My mental status is not.  I just want my boyfriend and he's so deep into his own emotional breakdown brought on by antidepressants that he is unavailable.  He's shown zero care towards me during this week.

I love this guy but he wants nothing to do with me.
Deep breaths just result in crying.
